scenario.summary: Threat actors use phishing lures themed as meeting invites and software updates to deliver masqueraded MSP360 RMM installers. Once established, the RMM agent executes PowerShell to deploy a redundant ScreenConnect client, which serves as a platform for transferring and executing various credential theft and information collection utilities.

hunt.name: Masqueraded MSP360 RMM Installer and Persistence
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the abuse of legitimate Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) software, specifically MSP360 (v2.5.0.67), used to establish an initial foothold. The adversary distributes the signed installer through social-engineering lures themed around Zoom, PDF updates, or meeting invitations. Once executed from a user profile, the installer elevates and installs persistent Windows services. We open by scoping existing RMM footprints, then use a gated lead query to identify suspicious execution patterns. If the lead is judged suspicious, the hunt fanned out to investigate service persistence and the rarity of the installer across the estate to distinguish a targeted attack from legitimate IT activity.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, vendor_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%msp360%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%rmm agent%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%msp360%'
config.description: Find hosts where MSP360 or RMM agent software is already installed to focus the investigation.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts currently running or with MSP360 installed. This provides context for where legitimate RMM activity is expected.

primitive_config.label: Identify RMM software footprint
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, vendor_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%msp360%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%rmm agent%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%msp360%'
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts currently running or with MSP360 installed. This provides context for where legitimate RMM activity is expected.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, process_hash_sha256, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%_rmm_v2.5.0.67_%' OR instr(',' || '{{rmm_hashes}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_hash_sha256) || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\users\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\downloads\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\temp\%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find RMM installer execution from user-writable paths using filenames designed to masquerade as common software or documents.
config.expected_signal: A process launch matching the RMM version or hash from a user directory. Silence suggests no such masqueraded installers were executed in the window.

primitive_config.label: Masqueraded RMM installer execution
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, process_hash_sha256, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%_rmm_v2.5.0.67_%' OR instr(',' || '{{rmm_hashes}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_hash_sha256) || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\users\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\downloads\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\temp\%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A process launch matching the RMM version or hash from a user directory. Silence suggests no such masqueraded installers were executed in the window.

config.objective: Review the process executions in masqueraded-installer-lead. Determine if the filenames (e.g. including 'Zoom', 'PDF', 'ECARD', 'INVITATION') combined with the RMM version string 'v2.5.0.67' indicate a social-engineering lure.
config.description: The agent reviews the lead query results to determine if the process filenames and paths suggest a phishing lure versus a legitimate admin action.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict on whether the execution is suspicious for a masqueraded lure.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of suspicious for any host showing masqueraded RMM execution from a user profile.

config.question: the gate-read verdict is suspicious for at least one host
config.condition: the gate-read verdict is suspicious for at least one host
config.description: Route to expensive corroboration queries only if the initial lead is judged suspicious.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, service_name, service_cmd_line, actor_user_name, time FROM hb_service_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(service_name) LIKE 'rmm.agent%' OR LOWER(service_cmd_line) LIKE '%rmm agent%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find evidence of successful RMM service installation following the lead execution.
config.expected_signal: Creation of RMM.Agent or RMM.Agent.Launcher services. Silence suggests elevation or installation failed.

primitive_config.label: RMM service persistence
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, service_name, service_cmd_line, actor_user_name, time FROM hb_service_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(service_name) LIKE 'rmm.agent%' OR LOWER(service_cmd_line) LIKE '%rmm agent%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Creation of RMM.Agent or RMM.Agent.Launcher services. Silence suggests elevation or installation failed.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_name) AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%_rmm_v2.5.0.67_%' OR instr(',' || '{{rmm_hashes}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_hash_sha256) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(process_name) HAVING hosts <= {{rare_threshold}}
config.description: Determine if the suspicious binary name or hash is rare across the fleet, which distinguishes targeted lures from wide software updates.
config.expected_signal: A stack-count showing the binary is unique or extremely rare. Silence on rarity suggests a broader, potentially legitimate deployment.

primitive_config.label: Installer rarity stack-count

primitive_config.expected: A stack-count showing the binary is unique or extremely rare. Silence on rarity suggests a broader, potentially legitimate deployment.

config.objective: Determine if any host has been successfully compromised via a masqueraded MSP360 installer. Correlate the suspicious execution identified in gate-read with the service creation and installer rarity.
config.description: A second agent weights the lead lure, the resulting service persistence, and the rarity of the event to reach a final verdict.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict of malicious for confirmed masqueraded installations.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of malicious for hosts showing the phishing lure followed by service persistence and binary rarity.

config.question: the final-triage verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.condition: the final-triage verdict is malicious for at least one host

Contain the threat before follow-on payloads like ScreenConnect are deployed.
config.instructions: Isolate the endpoint. Stop and delete the RMM.Agent and RMM.Agent.Launcher services. Collect the installer binary from the user's profile for forensic analysis.

config.description: Verify findings and check for redundant ScreenConnect deployment.
config.instructions: Review the lead and service rows. Specifically check if RMM.Agent.exe spawned PowerShell to download ClientSetup.msi, which indicates the second remote access channel has been deployed.
Record the examined hosts and findings. Document any legitimate MSP360 use cases to update the excluded scope for future periodic runs.
